# Instructions for GitHub Copilot in this repository

- Python 3.12. Keep code simple and readable: I must be able to explain every line.
- Allowed libraries: the standard library, requests, beautifulsoup4, pytest. Ask before suggesting any other dependency.
- Downloaded regulator text lives in `data/` and must never be committed or pasted into code.
- Be polite to websites: respect robots.txt, wait between requests, send a descriptive User-Agent.
- Every new function needs a pytest test in `tests/`.
- When I ask what code does, explain it in plain English first, then the details.
